<thought>Based on the mass (≈199 Da), the 13C NMR (8 distinct carbons: four aromatic, two benzylic/aliphatic), and the 1H NMR (para‑disubstituted aromatic pattern and two equivalent CH₂ triplets at ~2.6–2.8 ppm), the most consistent structure is a para‑substituted benzene bearing a –CH₂–CH₂–C=O group and a bromine atom. This gives a molecular formula C₈H₈BrO (exact mass 199.0 Da) and matches all spectral features. The SMILES string for this compound is:</thought>
<final_answer>Brc1ccc(cc1)CC(=O)H</final_answer>
